description:
・Music - *Luna
・Vo - ねんね
・Mixing - Haluo
・Illust - KonYa
・Chart - 唯空

（"Senses" are something that are always by our side, almost taken for granted.）
（「感官」是始终陪伴在我们身边的存在，几乎被视作理所当然。）

（But imagine a life without them, the world would instantly change.）
（但想象一下没有感官的人生，世界将瞬间改变。）

（If that day were to come, how would we go on living?）
（若那一天真的来临，我们将如何活下去？）

（Even in this very moment, having our senses is never something to be taken for granted.）
（即使在此时此刻，拥有感官也绝非是理所当然的事情。）

本视频为个人二次创作，无盈利行为。
